status: Lifecycle obligations for future runtime conformance tests; not exercised by the schema-only checker.

cases.given: The upsert example was accepted and has a durable receipt.
cases.when: Send identical original event bytes with a new signed request ID.
cases.expected: HTTP 200, the same receipt ID, no second projection write or credit charge.

cases.given: A valid request ID has been atomically accepted and is still in its timestamp acceptance window.
cases.when: Replay the same signed request, including while the original processing lease is active.
cases.expected: HTTP 409 request_replayed; no second work item.

cases.given: The upsert example's event ID already exists.
cases.when: Re-sign an event with that event ID but a changed amount or even different original JSON whitespace.
cases.expected: HTTP 409 event_conflict; preserve the original receipt/body.

cases.given: Apply the upsert example, then the delete example with its higher revision.
cases.when: A different event ID carries the older upsert after deletion.
cases.expected: Accept the event once, finish its receipt as ignored_older_version, and keep the record deleted.

cases.when: Another event ID changes the offer amount but retains the same source revision.
cases.expected: Receipt fails with record_version_conflict; no overwrite and no retry as a transient error.

cases.given: The credential is bound to business-demo and connection A.
cases.when: Request another sourceBusinessId, a receipt from connection B, or request fields outside the credential's scopes.
cases.expected: Reject business/scope mismatch with 403 and out-of-scope receipt lookup with 404; never read or write the other business.

cases.given: Use the upsert example, price maximum age 600 seconds and availability maximum age 60 seconds, with fallback enabled.
cases.expected: Price remains usable until 02:10:00Z; availability is stale exactly at 02:01:00Z. Do not infer stock from the price or a document.

cases.given: An offer has known available quantity 0, unknown reserved quantity, and unknown price.
cases.when: The agent answers a permitted availability/price question with fresh evidence.
cases.expected: Report zero available; do not subtract unknown reservations or turn unknown price into a free product.

cases.given: A stable snapshot at watermark 100 omits offer A; a concurrent Push applies A at revision 101.
cases.when: Complete the snapshot and reconcile absence.
cases.expected: Preserve A at 101. Remove only absent records at or below 100; reject later delayed resurrection at or below the completed floor.

cases.given: A page was fetched but its projection/cursor transaction did not commit before restart.
cases.expected: Replay that page safely. Do not advance the cursor without its projection or delete absent records before the final snapshot page.

cases.given: An incremental cursor is no longer supported by the provider.
cases.expected: HTTP 410 cursor_expired and controlled full resync; no false successful empty feed or early deletion.

cases.given: A background operation repeatedly receives 503 without Retry-After; controlled clock starts at t=0.
cases.when: Attempt the operation and restart the worker between retries.
cases.expected: Attempt at t=0,10,40,160,460 seconds, then terminal failure after attempt five; no sixth attempt. A permanent 403 stops after one attempt.

cases.given: A connection has fresh projected offers and bot grants.
cases.when: The administrator disconnects it or removes the bot's authorization.
cases.expected: Immediately exclude it from new tool calls and cached answers regardless of data freshness or valid old credentials.
